Direct measurement: EuropePMC unreachable from the audit host at 10:10Z (connection timeout, 30 s). The deployed host DID reach it at 08:48Z (RETRIEVE OK, 1 record). The release-relevant defect is confirmed by code inspection: discovery_fabric/a2/prior_art.py::search_prior_art_with_queries records per-query SEARCH_FAILED but, when ALL queries fail, still sets prior_art_status = NO_MATCHING_EVIDENCE_FOUND — a provider outage is silently converted into an absence claim (Art. XXI.3 violation, exactly SEARCH_FAILED != NO_MATCH_FOUND). PRIOR_ART_STATUS_MAP then maps NO_MATCHING_EVIDENCE_FOUND -> NO_MATCH_FOUND. Section 2/4 close this.

Same for GET /api/run/{id}/result. Release blocker for enterprise claims (section 15).

GET /api/run/ts_d1ab9fd4d756/result: final_status = AUTOMATED_INVENTION_CANDIDATE, prior_art_status = RESOLVED_DIFFERENTIATED, differentiation_resolution.n_search_errors = 5 (five of ten ladder searches FAILED), MULTI_SOURCE_DISCOVERY FAILED_EXPLICIT in the same run. Code root cause (discovery_fabric/prior_art_v2/collision_resolution.py): resolve_differentiation() never consults search_errors on the RESOLVED_DIFFERENTIATED branch, and run_collision computes searches_succeeded = bool(hits) or not errors — a single surviving query makes the whole search 'succeeded' even when the candidate's DISTINGUISHING/MECHANISM ladder steps failed. This is the release-blocking epistemic defect of section 2.
